claims: "and" is used to connect words, phrases, or clauses of equal importance.
"and" signifies addition, along with, or consequence.
Synonyms of "and" include "also", "as well as", "plus", and "moreover".
"and" is often pronounced as "'n'" in fast speech.
Some style guides advise against starting sentences with "and".
"and/or" is used to indicate one, more, or all options apply.
